summary.text: George Rauscher, a Republican, was appointed to the Alaska Senate (District O) in November 2025 after serving in the Alaska House of Representatives, where he took office in 2017.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, Rauscher moved to Alaska in the late 1970s, began his career in the oil fields, and founded his own construction business in 1992.
He served on the Sutton Community Council and, in the House, chaired the Energy Committee and served as Majority Whip.
